change.scope: Topology-derived logical rank order for selected AllReduce rs_ag; original scheduling candidates are preserved.
change.permutations: Greedy binary group merges from worst-direction shortest-path prices; locality uses edge inverse bandwidth, resource adds every resource inverse capacity.
change.semantics: Physical network/rank IDs remain original. Logical XOR partner, shard ownership and contributor groups use the same permutation. Chunks and initial possession are emitted in original task order.

screening.note: Path-work scores exclude aggregate contention and startup; full integer Replay and semantic validation decide adoption.

change.model_reply: Existing c candidate rows plus optional m: 0 original, 1 locality, 2 resource; omitted means automatic proxy choice.
change.pipeline: Generate inexpensive mapping scores before the model call; prepare one mapping prediction during model waiting; reuse mapped planner caches after the actual model response.
change.adoption: Lower complete communication estimate and non-increasing ln(time)+0.10*response_MB after full validation.
change.isolation: Mapped planners have private plan/allocation/expression caches and share only physical network/route data with other candidates.
change.unchanged: Original portfolio, 6-second single model-call cap, 120 output-token limit, split/alignment constraints and 100-ms final route repair.

new_coverage: Arbitrary logical permutation preserves original chunk order, possession, physical paths and complete semantics
AG/doubling/tree and partial rs_ag depths validate with full and compact sum notation
Mapped prediction equals independent complete Replay estimate
Bandwidth, reverse-direction and shared-capacity mutations alter generated orders
Mapped route refinement uses the mapped planner
Model m=0 versus m=1 materially changes current-instance selection
Model-linked mapping tools and prepared prediction cache reuse
Slower mapped candidate rejected before full build

model.quality_limit: Controlled replies verify selection mechanics, not actual model quality or official score.

checks: 68 valid responses, one SDK model call each, and no model/portfolio/select errors
34 pairs preserve original built candidate configurations, estimates, statuses and sources
Mapped variants retain split and round count and pass original-input semantic validation
Every adopted mapped variant improves complete Replay by at least 3 percent before final repair and does not increase complete selection cost
Non-mapped pairs preserve per-round transfer/chunk semantics
Bandwidth, resource and direction mutations change input hashes and actual model prompt content without changing instance ID
Identical-input model controls receive identical model requests and candidate rows; only reply m changes, producing a different valid selected schedule
http_comparison.order: Two public repeats reverse version order per case; four mutation pairs and two model-control pairs; one warmup pair excluded.
http_comparison.p95_method: Inclusive linear interpolation over 28 public HTTP requests per version.

messages.content: You pick collective-communication schedule parameters. acceptance.communication: Two public AR cases improved by more than 3 percent in both repeats.
acceptance.status: submission candidate; latency target slightly exceeded; official evaluation pending

exploratory_fixed_parameter_study.stage: Initial offline heuristic study before runtime screening and preparation changes.

limitations: No official hidden input, official Replay run or real model call was used.
Mapping gains here are concentrated in Uneven Pods AR and Sparse Fabric AR. Mesh2D AR, NVLink-like AR and Fullmesh Clos AR mapping trials were rejected.
Mean HTTP overhead is 152.4 ms, slightly above the proposed 150-ms experimental target; P95 also increased.
The unchanged 100-ms wall-clock route-repair search remains timing-sensitive; final non-mapped estimates varied by up to about 0.232 percent in this comparison.
A model choosing a different mapping or parameters can discard prepared work or require another prediction; only one extra complete mapped schedule is built.
Actual model inference cost, token count and total official score improvement remain unmeasured.
